task.summary: Setting up the Fluxxor process by hooking in the services, actions, and stores together. The ground work for uploading music is completed.
Disabled a few middleware modules I wasn't using Configured multipart uploading with Multer Layed down the ground work for Song/Album/Artist model creation
Creating the models when uploading song files is working. Still need to work on song meta data and injecting the user into the req.
Fixed duplicate entry issue. Stupid findOneOrCreate crap
Added cover art extration support for Albums
Added authticated routes and redis session
Hooked up front end to backend for /music/list and rendering out the list of songs. Need to work on design and error handling.
Finishing up ground work for /music/list. Will need to add filters to the list and selectively update records the client already knows about.
The navbar now can navigate to the different sections
Initial state set for music list
Added sort dropdown that keeps state of the sort column
Added client side sorting of music based on the option selected from the drop down
